expo.name: Once Upon a Line

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Once Upon a Line uses your location while the app is open to pop up fun facts when you are near a ride.

plugins.cameraPermission: Once Upon a Line uses your camera to snap photo spots while you wait in line. Photos stay on your device unless you share them.
plugins.photosPermission: Once Upon a Line can use photos from your library for your line keepsakes.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: Once Upon a Line saves your keepsake cards and photo spots to your photos when you ask it to.
plugins.photosPermission: Once Upon a Line saves your keepsake cards and photo spots to your photos when you ask it to.

expo.description: Line-time storybook adventures for Walt Disney World: trivia, I Spy and challenges while you wait.
